title: Family Sari-Sari Store Inventory & Daily Sales Ledger
summary: Automated Excel ledger tracking daily cash flow, wholesale supplier margins, retail markup, and restocking alerts for a family micro-retail store.
problem: Manual paper notebook records caused unrecorded inventory shrink, missing credit payment tracking, and inaccurate end-of-day profit balancing.
whatIDid: Architected an automated Excel workbook with dynamic SKU lookup formulas, input data validation, and conditional formatting.
Engineered an automated Daily Sales Reconciliation sheet calculating gross margin, cash-on-hand differences, and customer ledger receivables.
Formulated dynamic low-stock alert triggers highlighting items with under 3 days of average daily velocity.
Designed a streamlined mobile-friendly sheet view enabling single-tap tally updates during rush hours.
result: Transitioned 100% of store sales logging from paper to digital tracking across 140+ active household grocery items [REAL FAMILY BUSINESS WORK SAMPLE].
